meta.description: Versioned clinical thresholds and quality constraints for contactless multimodal neurological monitoring decision support.

lighting.instruction: Lighting is too dim. Please illuminate your hand and face from the front.

facial_visibility.instruction: Please ensure your entire face is directly facing the camera at eye level.

postural_framing.instruction: Position yourself so your upper torso, shoulders, and hands are visible in the frame.

rejection_reasons.HAND_OUTSIDE_FRAME: Your hand is partially outside the frame. Move your hand into the highlighted area.
rejection_reasons.HAND_NOT_DETECTED: No hand detected in the frame. Please hold your hand open facing the camera.
rejection_reasons.LOW_FRAME_RATE: Camera frame rate is too low (< 15 FPS) for reliable kinematic tracking. Please close background tabs.
rejection_reasons.LOW_CONFIDENCE: Hand tracking confidence is low. Ensure your hand is well-lit and not occluded.
rejection_reasons.EXCESSIVE_DROPPED_FRAMES: High dropped-frame ratio detected. Retake is recommended for valid timing.

audio_snr.instruction: Move to a quieter room and speak clearly into the microphone.

emergency_fast_protocol.banner_text: CRITICAL HEALTH ALERT: Possible acute neurological indicators observed. Seek emergency medical attention immediately (e.g., dial 911 / emergency services). Do not wait for further assessments.
